doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: Bands Bailey played with: Young Tuxedo, Kelly, Celestin
summary: Bailey sums up playing with his brother in Young Tuxedo, Jack Carey, Chris Kelly for six years and Papa Celestin.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: I played with them. I played with them. I didn't play with them regularly, but the most I was playing with my brother, we had the Young Tuxedo. We was running this town. Wasn't none of them bands hardly could do anything with us. We had a good band. We used to play at Vicki Adams in the town of the Pawn Garden was open there, Aiden Rampo. We used to play there one time. Then we used to play for the Bulls. I played with Jack Carroll for quite a while and I played with Chris Kelly about six years. I played with Papa Celestine in the town of the district was open down there, a few close. He was running two bands. I played with him six months down there. And last year I was playing with Chris Kelly was on steam with Capitano in 1921.
